recentItems.title: 2 more people found alive 10 days after devastating Nepal floods
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: AI-powered surveillance cameras are spreading in Canada
recentItems.description:
Automatic licence plate recognition cameras are in the spotlight as citizens across North America question their use by municipalities and law enforcement agencies — with some critics calling them a tool for ‘mass surveillance.’ 

One company in particular, Flock Safety, has found itself at the heart of the debate and while the company’s tech has yet to be used in Canada, greater awareness about these AI-powered cameras is raising questions about how Canadian ALPR camera makers operate.

recentItems.title: Why Germany's far-right AfD has surged in popularity | The Current
recentItems.description:
This Sunday, Germans head to the polls in Saxony-Anhalt, where the far-right Alternative for Germany party — or AfD — is surging in the eastern state. If it wins, it would mark the first time a far-right party has held state power in Germany since the Nazis. CBC’s Jessica Singer has been on the ground, following the campaign and speaking with voters in the state capital, Magdeburg.
